name: Foot-operated switch
summary: A foot-operated switch uses a pedal mechanism to change an electrical contact.
description: A foot-operated switch uses a pedal mechanism to change an electrical contact. Its schematic should state the contact state and whether the operator is momentary or retained.
readingNotes: Identify the pedal's return action and any guard shown by the equipment specification.
